next.reason: 1985: 'File-name-1 may only reference a sequential file.' In 2023 a report file's FD is Format 3 (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR8 'Format 3 is the file description entry for a report file'), not the relative/indexed Format 2 (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR7); its file control entry can only be Format 3, which 'shall be specified only for a sequential file or a report file' (§2023:12.4.5.2 SR11) and 'defines a file connector for a sequential file' (§2023:12.4.5.3 GR8), Formats 1 and 2 being indexed and relative only (§2023:12.4.5.2 SR8, SR9). Same compile-time refusals.
